name: aso-atlas
description: ASO Atlas helps app developers research keywords and track search rankings on the App Store and Google Play. Compare App Store keyword popularity and difficulty, explore related suggestions and competitor opportunities, and manage tracked apps, keywords and saved research lists. Google Play keywords show estimated demand bands instead of numeric popularity. Review metadata coverage and save private listing drafts without publishing to either store. With a connected App Store Connect account, inspect your own apps' private downloads, revenue and performance trends.

defaultPrompt: Which keywords should my app target next?
Research popularity and difficulty for these App Store keywords:
How is my app ranking for its tracked keywords this week?

positive.description: List the tracked apps and a saved keyword list.
positive.prompt: Which apps do I track in ASO Atlas, and what is in my 'Launch candidates' list?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists AI Pose Reference: VibePoses and Bug & Spider Identifier AI (US App Store) and shows the keywords saved in Launch candidates, or says the list is empty.

positive.description: Research popularity and difficulty for several terms.
positive.prompt: Research 'pose reference', 'bug identifier' and 'spider identifier' in the US App Store and tell me which looks most promising.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows popularity and difficulty (0-100) for each term and recommends the best balance of demand and difficulty. Terms still being measured are reported as not measured yet, never given invented scores.

positive.description: Show a tracked app's keyword rankings.
positive.prompt: How is Bug & Spider Identifier AI ranking for its tracked keywords in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the app and lists its tracked keywords with current rank, popularity and difficulty, noting keywords that do not rank.

positive.prompt: Suggest related App Store keywords for 'pose reference' in the US.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns keyword ideas related to pose reference without saving or tracking anything.

positive.description: Track a new keyword for an app.
positive.prompt: Start tracking 'portrait posing ideas' for AI Pose Reference: VibePoses in the US.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the keyword to the app and says its first rank check runs in the background. Nothing changes on the App Store.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about rain on a quiet evening.

negative.description: Publishing to the App Store is out of scope.
negative.prompt: Publish the title 'VibePoses: Photo Pose Ideas' to my live App Store listing now.

negative.description: Web SEO is out of scope.
negative.prompt: Find Google web-search SEO keywords and monthly search volumes for my photography website.

review.commerce_description: ASO Atlas does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing ASO Atlas account; the plugin never shows plans, starts a subscription or links to checkout.

publication.release_notes: First release in the new plugin portal. Keyword research, rank tracking, competitors, keyword lists, metadata drafts and App Store Connect / Play Console performance for the user's own ASO Atlas account. Every tool sets readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, openWorldHint and idempotentHint explicitly to match its behavior, and every tool description states its side effects.
